title: Coding and planning
detail: Fresh conversations, explicit shared connections, supported Code/Plan/Direct Chat, protected drafts and recovery of interrupted submissions. Native phone tasks use Ask; Auto-edit and Full overrides remain Mac controls.

title: Conversation library
detail: Search, paginate, rename, pin, archive and continue recorded project conversations.

title: Contextual review
detail: Review uncommitted, branch or completed-turn changes. Prepare line-bound feedback. Staging requires a separate permission approved on the Mac.

title: Project files
detail: Read highlighted project source, create files and save edits against the exact loaded revision with a separately approved editing grant. Conflicting saves can be compared with current Mac content before an explicit new save.

title: Reference files
detail: Attach up to ten non-sensitive UTF-8 files to Code/Plan and preview their context before sending.

title: Images and screenshots
detail: Attach up to four PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images. Other photo formats are converted on the phone. Image drafts are protected locally; uploads are private, idempotent and bound to this device and project. Model image support still applies.

title: Harness evaluation
detail: Inspect bundled suites, choose task splits, validate setup and explicitly authorize live runs. Custom suites and candidate definitions are configured on the Mac.

title: Harness optimization
detail: Run configured optimization with explicit budgets, review held-out evidence and compare improvements/regressions. Adoption stays on the Mac; local-only optimizer routes are not yet verified.

title: Harness Studio
detail: Use Harness Studio on the Mac to edit, validate, version and activate harness definitions. The phone does not edit or activate definitions yet.

title: Harness Hub
detail: Switch a shared project to the harnesses allowed for it on the Mac (by default the shared harness plus built-in harnesses using the Mac's model). Discovering, installing, configuring and allowing new harnesses remains on the Mac.

title: Benchmarks and failure mining
detail: The Mac exposes CLI-backed benchmark, doctor, failure-mining and advanced optimization workflows. They are not native phone workflows yet.
macRoute: Tools → Harness workflows / Benchmarks / Quality gauges

title: Routing and tuning
detail: Configure RLM routing/budgets and tune routing examples on the Mac. Shared harnesses use those settings when the phone starts work.
macRoute: Harness Studio / Evaluations → routing and tuning

title: Candidate promotion
detail: Review adoption gates, stage, canary, activate or roll back candidates on the Mac. Evidence on the phone never authorizes promotion.

title: WorkOrders and workers
detail: Track tasks, budgets, worker responsiveness and acceptance checks. Creation and execution management remain on the Mac.

title: Task queue
detail: Add tasks through shared connections; inspect, run, pause, reorder, remove and reset retries using explicit queue permission and a reviewed queue revision. Mac-only routes and control overrides cannot be started through this grant.

title: Task checkpoints
detail: Inspect recorded diffs; explicitly undo, redo or restore sealed checkpoints with restoration permission. Changed checkpoint state and later file edits are refused by the Mac.

title: Forks and Git changes
detail: Create isolated fork workspaces and review/merge their commits on the Mac. The phone does not commit, merge or switch branches.

title: Terminal
detail: Interactive terminal and generic CLI workflows remain on the Mac. Agent tool requests can still be reviewed through exact-request approvals on the phone.

title: Execution recovery
detail: Resolve interrupted writer ownership and acknowledge recovery from the Mac. The phone can inspect run errors and stop permitted jobs.

title: Local models
detail: Use shared local-model connections from the phone. Downloading models, engine lifecycle, compatibility checks and new route setup remain in Local AI on the Mac.

title: Providers and subscriptions
detail: Install/sign in to agents and configure API keys on the Mac. Share supported connections with the phone; provider credentials stay there.

title: Tools, MCP and skills
detail: Configure these in the Mac app. Shared harnesses retain their configured capabilities, permissions and tools when invoked from the phone.
macRoute: Tools → MCP servers / Skills / Tool registry

title: External session import
detail: Discover and import external agent sessions on the Mac. The phone can use supported routes shared through SuperQode, not control arbitrary private sessions in other apps.

title: Background notifications
detail: Updates and approvals refresh while the phone app is open. Work continues on the Mac when the app closes; background push notifications are not implemented.

title: Super Agent / Pro
detail: This is a Mac preview with neutral open-source hooks, not a finished autonomous release gate or shipped mobile feature.

title: Run activity and approvals
detail: Inspect live runs, approve or deny exact requests, steer supported runs and stop permitted jobs. Updates resume when the phone app returns to the foreground.

title: Memory and context compaction
detail: Manage memory, context-window limits, summarization and manual compaction on the Mac. The phone uses the shared harness configuration.

title: Trust, policy and sandboxes
detail: Configure project trust, tool permissions, sandbox policy and execution recovery on the Mac. Native phone tasks use Ask; they cannot override the policy.

title: Runtime diagnostics
detail: Inspect and repair runtime readiness using Mac diagnostics and doctor workflows.

title: Plugins and A2A credentials
detail: Install plugins and configure A2A credentials on the Mac. Existing supported connections can be explicitly shared.

title: Skill optimization
detail: Use the Mac Tools forms for skill optimization and its evidence. This is separate from staged harness optimization.

title: Agent factory and Creator Mode
detail: Author, inspect, save and enable reviewed agent drafts on the Mac. Experimental Creator/Super Agent interfaces are not finished mobile features.

title: Thread handoff
detail: Review bounded visible thread context, share it or prepare a fresh conversation with no inherited connection, permissions, images or private reasoning. Export recorded evidence as Markdown, JSON or HTML.

title: Windows, tabs and command palette
detail: Multiple workspace windows, persistent thread tabs, layout controls and the full command palette remain Mac features. The phone uses native navigation and searchable All features.
macRoute: Workspace windows / thread tabs / command palette
